candidate.claim: hash() with numeric salt calls genSalt then unconditionally calls _hash with the salt result without checking err, so a genSalt failure is masked and _hash is invoked with undefined salt producing a different error.
candidate.title: hash ignores genSalt error before calling _hash

verifier.reason: The callback at index.js:174-175 receives err but unconditionally calls _hash(password, salt, callback, progressCallback), and genSalt invokes callback(err) with no salt value on failure at index.js:125-126, so the original error is ignored and _hash receives undefined salt.

candidate.claim: genSalt throws synchronously for non-number rounds even when a callback was supplied, while hash/compare deliver argument errors via callback; an async caller with callback gets an unexpected synchronous throw.
candidate.title: genSalt throws instead of callback on illegal rounds

verifier.reason: genSalt at index.js:117-118 throws synchronously for non-number rounds before the callback handling at index.js:131-134 is reached, so a supplied callback is never invoked for that argument error.

candidate.claim: base64_decode breaks on invalid c1/c2/c3 but does not check c4 for -1 before OR-ing it into the output byte, producing an out-of-range byte (65535) and incrementing olen instead of stopping.
candidate.title: base64_decode missing invalid check for c4

verifier.reason: Confirmed at index.js:491-496: c4 is assigned -1 for invalid codes with no c4==-1 break unlike c1/c2 at index.js:479 and c3 at index.js:486, then o|=c4 yields -1, String.fromCharCode(-1) is 65535, and ++olen includes it in the result.
